events.title: Citizen Pain Demo - Patch 3 Release Notes
events.summary: I've released a new update for the Citizen Pain II Demo!I've been watching your gameplay videos and streams, and your feedback has been incredibly helpful! Thanks to everyone who has played the demo and shared their experience.This update brings combat improvements, bug fixes, and refinements to the overall experience. Thank you for your continued support! Release Notes (v0.0.8.1.b)Combat Fixes: Restored enemy super armor to prevent players from repeatedly staggering enemies by spamming attacks.

events.title: Citizen Pain Demo - Patch 2 Release Notes
events.summary: I've released a small update for the Citizen Pain II Demo!Visual Fix: Fixed an issue causing a potion to display incorrectly in a room.Equipment Placement: Adjusted the sword's position in a hazard room.Soul Spawn System: Introduced a probability-based system for soul spawns, including additional souls and healing souls.Thank you for playing Citizen Pain II and for your continued support!

events.title: Citizen Pain Demo - Patch 1 Release Notes
events.summary: I've released a quick update for the Citizen Pain II Demo! Release Notes (v0.0.8.1)Soundtrack Update: Replaced the battle music track to address potential automated Content ID claims on YouTube and Twitch.Content creators and streamers can now enjoy the updated soundtrack when recording or streaming their gameplay.Thank you for playing Citizen Pain II and supporting the game during Steam Next Fest!
